repositories.reason: Keep the Dart/FFI, Map, TypedData and lifecycle contract: official unpublished 0.4.0 fails application resolution and its native Map probe. This pin backports applicable safety fixes to the matched d07f6b5 QuickJS-NG core without changing wrapper APIs.

required_patches: Map/TypedData conversion and dispatch/port lifetime contract
Current platform build and integer/NaN API compatibility
official_review.validation: Official 0.4.0 commit fails current meta/hook resolution and the Map native probe. The retained core now has bounded native GC, allocation-failure and transfer regressions; Linux ASan/UBSan and application platform checks remain required.
official_review.exit_condition: Adopt official source after solver, Map/TypedData, Promise/cancellation, secure native core and platform acceptance pass.

repositories.reason: Official stable 6.1.5 lacks the browser-exit event. Use the exact official parent of the previous fork; Windows instance ownership alone remains a local override.

official_review.validation: Selected official parent and previous fork differ only in the two Windows ownership files; the six official Git packages keep the existing APIs and dependencies.
official_review.exit_condition: Prefer a stable release once it exposes the required browser-exit API; update all platform sources together.

local_packages.reason: Reader-specific scale/reset APIs and image, controller and gesture lifetime patches are maintained with the application.

required_patches: Reader scale, animateScale and reset APIs
official_review.validation: Official stable replacement produces 15 application API errors; official source still discards an ImageInfo reference.
official_review.exit_condition: Remove local source when public scale/reset adapters and upstream ownership fixes pass reader and image lifecycle tests.

local_packages.reason: Native sharing payload, file retention and callback ownership fixes require coordinated application and platform validation.

required_patches: Windows immutable payload and callback/collection ownership
official_review.validation: Official stable/head still differ in native payload ownership and cache retention. Application serial queuing alone does not establish native safety.
official_review.exit_condition: Adopt official source after concurrent sharing, callback disposal and retained-file native regressions pass.

local_packages.reason: Cancellation-safe Rust/Dart callback draining and locked native dependency security fixes are maintained with the application.

required_patches: Cancellation-safe callback completion for the current bridge
official_review.validation: Official 0.18.0 lock matches 10 package versions with advisories; latest official Git lock is byte-identical. Official bridge removes old send panic, but strict OHOS loading adaptation is still pending.
official_review.exit_condition: Adopt official release/commit only after secure Cargo lock, matched FRB/generated code, strict OHOS loading and newly compiled native cancellation/TLS/platform acceptance.

local_packages.reason: Retains the adapter, redirect, upload and authentication patches used by WebDAV reading and backup without maintaining a separate fork.

required_patches: Redirect, multiple authentication, upload and cancellation behavior
official_review.validation: Official adapter can be set after construction, but authentication/301/upload/cancellation still differ; the official package invokes a Dio internal API.
official_review.exit_condition: Adopt official source after adapter migration and authentication, redirect, upload, download and cancellation regressions pass.

local_packages.reason: Retain the pinned desktop proxy, Linux WebKit/libsoup and ARM64 implementation; official 0.4.2 requires Flutter 3.44 and changes configuration APIs.

required_patches: Linux WebKit/libsoup and Windows ARM64 support
official_review.validation: Compatible official 0.3.2 lacks proxy and setOnNavigation; 0.4.2 requires a newer Flutter SDK.
official_review.exit_condition: Adopt official source or a unified desktop browser after proxy, login, interception and supported-platform native acceptance.

local_packages.reason: Project-owned ownership-safe PNG and 7z bridges replace wrappers with placeholder licenses; retain explicitly licensed official native cores.

Project-authored persistent Android document-provider IO replaces the placeholder-license wrapper while retaining stored paths and grants, descriptor ownership, error propagation and native 64-bit operations.
Retain only the two Windows GraphicsContext instance ownership changes and adapt the interface dependency to the same official SHA.

required_patches: Instance-owned GraphicsContext and release after WebView cleanup
official_review.validation: Exact previous native ownership patch retained on the official parent. Newly resolved official interface uses the same full SHA; Windows multiwindow acceptance is required.
official_review.exit_condition: Drop the override when official source includes the ownership patch and close/recreate, proxy, Cookie and login acceptance pass.
